resources.string: Keep session on the server (tmux)
Each tab runs in its own tmux session on the server. Reconnecting, or opening TermiNow again, attaches to it with its programs still running.
tmux is not on this server

%1$s has no tmux, so this tab is a normal login and ends with the connection.\n\nInstall tmux? TermiNow types the install command into this tab, with sudo unless you are root; the server may ask for your password.
